blocks.text: Sugarloaf Mountain and a jeep tour through Tijuca Forest

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word day heading names only Rio, and the Day 3 entry omits the Tijuca jeep tour.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you’ll take a guided tour of Sugarloaf Mountain lasting about four hours. The first stop is on Urca Mountain, where there’s a wide viewing platform and a choice of restaurants. From there, the cable car takes you up to Sugarloaf.

From the summit you can see Copacabana, Guanabara Bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Niterói Bridge and Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado. It’s an especially good place to see the curve of the shoreline, the mouth of the bay and the boats on the water.

In the afternoon, you’ll take a jeep tour through Tijuca Forest, a large stretch of Atlantic Forest within the city. The air smells of damp leaves, and monkeys, sloths and tropical birds live among the trees. Your guide will explain why the Mata Atlântica matters to the region’s wildlife and landscapes.

The tour includes a walk of about an hour. The planned route takes you to the Vista Chinesa lookout and includes a stop at natural pools where you can swim. In one day, you’ll see Rio from above the ocean and from within its dense urban forest.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word Day 3 covers only the Sugarloaf outing. It lacks the afternoon jeep tour, the walk, Vista Chinesa and the swimming stop in this combined block.
